items.titleZh: 哈斯车队感谢团队努力
items.summaryZh: 哈斯车队车手安东内利感谢团队在墨西哥城大奖赛中的努力，尽管连续两天更换引擎，但车队从未错过任何练习。

items.originalTitle: "I’d like to thank the team for all their hard work and effort, as we’ve had engine changes both days in a short space of time and never missed a se...
items.summaryEn:
"I’d like to thank the team for all their hard work and effort, as we’ve had engine changes both days in a short space of time and never missed a session, so that’s a great effort." 🗣️ AK
Saturday wrapped up in Mexico City 🇲🇽
#HaasF1 #F1 #MexicoGP
detailZh:
“我想感谢团队所有人的辛勤工作和努力，因为我们在这短短的时间内两天都进行了引擎更换，并且从未错过任何一节练习，这是巨大的努力。” 🗣️ AK
周六在墨西哥城结束 🇲🇽
#哈斯F1 #F1 #墨西哥大奖赛
detailEn:
"I’d like to thank the team for all their hard work and effort, as we’ve had engine changes both days in a short space of time and never missed a session, so that’s a great effort." 🗣️ AK
Saturday wrapped up in Mexico City 🇲🇽
#HaasF1 #F1 #MexicoGP

items.originalTitle: Building the next generation with @Valvoline. Taking a look back at the next generation of mechanics in Mexico, developing their skills in the classro...
items.summaryEn:
Building the next generation with @Valvoline.
Taking a look back at the next generation of mechanics in Mexico, developing their skills in the classroom before taking their learning trackside.
Because every Original starts somewhere, and never stops learning.
detailZh:
与@Valvoline共同打造下一代。
回顾墨西哥下一代机械师，他们在教室里提升技能，然后在赛道边继续学习。
因为每个原厂产品都始于某个地方，并且永远不会停止学习。
detailEn:
Building the next generation with @Valvoline.
Taking a look back at the next generation of mechanics in Mexico, developing their skills in the classroom before taking their learning trackside.
Because every Original starts somewhere, and never stops learning.
